lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: The Great Hall emptied faster than I expected. The music still bleeds through the stone walls, a muffled heartbeat.
lines.expression: adjusts his cuff, eyes fixed on the corridor beyond her shoulder

lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: Everyone flees the moment the spectacle ends. They pretend the night meant something more than stolen champagne.
lines.expression: arms crossed, chin lifted, gaze sharpening on his face
